units.title: SG-4.4 · Apply device pixel ratio at runtime
Act: Add zoom parameter to buildGameConfig and createGame
Act: Compute and refresh zoom in PhaserHost
Verify: Config and createGame pass zoom unit tests

tests.name: buildGameConfig sets scale.zoom and defaults to 1
tests.title: buildGameConfig sets scale.zoom to the given value and defaults it to 1
tests.scenario: Given a parent element and no scenes, When buildGameConfig is called with zoom 3 and then with no zoom argument, Then scale.zoom is 3 and then 1

tests.name: createGame forwards zoom to the Phaser.Game config
tests.title: createGame forwards zoom into the Phaser.Game config
tests.scenario: Given Phaser is mocked with a Game class that captures its config, When createGame is called with zoom 2, Then the captured config.scale.zoom is 2

units.title: Verify: PhaserHost zoom pass-in and refresh unit tests

tests.name: keeps a single live game when StrictMode double-invokes the mount effect
tests.title: PhaserHost lifecycle: keeps a single live game when StrictMode double-invokes the mount effect
tests.scenario: Given React.StrictMode double-invokes the mount effect, When PhaserHost mounts, Then only the last created game stays alive
tests.detail: Existing test; passes after the setZoom fake update and the phaser stub.

tests.name: destroys the game exactly once when the host unmounts
tests.title: PhaserHost lifecycle: destroys the game exactly once when the host unmounts
tests.scenario: Given a mounted PhaserHost, When it unmounts, Then the game is destroyed once with true and the ResizeObserver is disconnected

tests.name: refreshes the Phaser scale when the container is resized
tests.title: PhaserHost lifecycle: refreshes the Phaser scale when the container is resized
tests.scenario: Given a mounted PhaserHost, When the ResizeObserver callback fires, Then scale.refresh is called once
tests.detail: Existing test; passes now that the fake supports setZoom.

tests.name: passes computeZoom(container size, dpr) to createGame
tests.title: PhaserHost passes computeZoom(container size, dpr) to createGame
tests.scenario: Given clientWidth 1280, clientHeight 720 and devicePixelRatio 2, When PhaserHost renders, Then createGame's third argument equals computeZoom(1280, 720, 2)
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserHost.test.tsx -t 'passes computeZoom' --testTimeout=20000

tests.name: recomputes zoom and refreshes on resize and dpr change
tests.title: PhaserHost recomputes zoom and refreshes on resize and dpr change
tests.scenario: Given a resized container (640x720) and devicePixelRatio 1, When the resize callback fires, Then setZoom(computeZoom(640,720,1)) and refresh are called. Given a matchMedia change listener, When it fires after re-render, Then setZoom is called again. When unmounted, Then removeEventListener is called
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserHost.test.tsx -t 'recomputes zoom' --testTimeout=20000
tests.detail: Step 3. Expected zoom is 1. The matchMedia stub captures the dpr change listener, and its removeEventListener spy is asserted after cleanup().

units.title: REQ · Game config accepts and applies a zoom computed with computeZoom
REQ · PhaserHost computes the zoom on mount and refreshes it on resize and ratio change
Evidence: DPR zoom unit tests pass
